newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: LOW SUPPLY KEEPS SRI LANKA RUBBER PRICES BUOYANT.
newsitem.headline: LOW SUPPLY KEEPS SRI LANKA RUBBER PRICES BUOYANT.

text.p: Low supply due to rain in growing areas kept rubber prices up at the Colombo auctions, traders said on Thursday.
"We have had an unusually long wet spell this year, which has reduced tapping days," said a trader at brokers Forbes & Walker.
"Supplies will be low even after the rains stop due to a leaf disease, which is brought on by prolonged wet weather," he added.
Number one rose to 84.50 rupees per kg from 83.50, number two to 79.25 from 79. Number three was steady at 64 rupees a kg, they said.
Sole crepe was also steady at 130 rupees a kg.
A total of 190 tonnes was on offer. ($=58.90 rupees).
